dataList.title: Investigate 5F
dataList.description: We finally reached 5F with Pwie. There's no telling what we'll encounter on this floor, but we should keep exploring.

dataList.title: Head to B1F
dataList.description: Apparently, we're still lacking in "virtue" to enter 5F. Pwie said they need to wear a Golden Shroud, and that somewhere down on the underground floors, there's someone who can process hides. Let's head there.

dataList.title: Head to the Inner Part of 5F
dataList.description:
The Overseer completed the Golden Hide, allowing Pwie to don clothing made from it. Pwie, however, doesn't seem glad at all after devouring Wriggley.
... It's time to head to 5F.

steps.goalDescription1: Head to the Inner Part of 5F
Face the Noir Blocking the Path

dataList.title: Approach the Curtain Beyond 5F
dataList.description: We dealt with the onslaught of enemies on 5F. Now it's time to head to the inside and lay our hands on the curtain. With the Golden Shroud on Pwie, things may turn out different this time.

dataList.title: Kill Le Noir's Brand Manager
dataList.description: We need to defeat the Le Noir Brand Manager who's standing in the way.

dataList.title: Observe Buffet
dataList.description:
The cocoon finally parted.
Let's see what Buffet will transform into.

steps.goalDescription1: Keep Observing Buffet until the End

dataList.title: Enter the Restaurant
dataList.description: We were able to venture beyond the curtain that had been blocking our path on 5F.

dataList.title: Protect the Cocoon from the Le Noir Onslaught
dataList.description:
Pwie told us they were feeling tired moments before they fell asleep and became a cocoon. Seemingly having discovered the cocoon's location, a small army of Le Noir have arrived here to destroy it.

Let's protect Pwie.

steps.goalDescription1: Protect the Cocoon from the Le Noir Onslaught

dataList.title: Kill Blackthread
dataList.description: We should deal with the Blackthread and open the path.
